recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、細胞質淡藍灰並向四周伸出細毛狀突起，是毛細胞白血病中的毛細胞。
features: Single medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Thick-area background of closely packed red cells
Only one cell shown at moderate magnification; fine detail limited
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at moderate magnification shows a single medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, homogeneous chromatin and pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine hair-like projections around the circumference. No other leukocytes are present in this field, and the thick smear area and magnification limit assessment of nuclear detail. Findings are suggestive of a hairy cell; in the context of lymphocytosis with numerous such cells, hairy cell leukemia is favored and should be confirmed by flow cytometry and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Cells show a prominent nucleolus and are CD25 and ANXA1 negative with wild-type BRAF.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and a phenotype lacking CD103 and CD123 co-expression.
Artifactual projections in thick areas occur on otherwise normal small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm.
